It comes into play as enchantment. Whenever enemy hero casts a sorcery spell with variable casting cost it becomes X/X pale aspect Pale creature possessing Dissipation, Cryptic Manifestation and Final Courtesy abilities, where X is the amount of ether used to cast the sorcery that has triggered this ability
